fact: Seychelles Cable Systems stated that operators in Seychelles could carry traffic over the PEACE submarine cable from 16 November 2022; the 15,000 km cable connects Pakistan, Seychelles, Kenya, Djibouti and France.

Submarine Networks reported on 1 May 2023 that the SEAS cable connecting Seychelles and Tanzania, owned by the Seychelles Cable Systems company of the government and two operators, was the country's first international cable and still carried Intelvision's international traffic; the date is the document's published date.
